suggestions.quote: Here's how it works. Each chip is one person's chance at the one thing they'd choose... with nobody watching. It never tells you what that thing is.
suggestions.fix: Two rule lines while you only nod. Drop the teacher opener and play it on the chip in frame: "His chip moves when he turns the page. It starts where the crowd starts. It never says what he wants."

keep.quote: You can't borrow someone's odds. Only their apron.
Her eight was music, all along. A year of notes... copied from someone who doesn't want the exam.
The biggest number? It tells you what's likely. It can't tell you what's worth choosing.
